name: TW Post Modifier Tracker
author: Technology Wisdom

sections.description:
TW Post Modifier Tracker is a lightweight plugin that helps editorial teams, site managers, and content creators track content updates.
It adds a new column to the WordPress Posts, Pages, WooCommerce Products, and Custom Post Types admin lists, showing the date/time of the last modification and the user who made the change, with no configuration needed.

Whether you’re managing a multi author site or auditing content activity, this plugin gives you clear visibility into post updates at a glance.

Features:

  • Adds a “Last Modified” column to the admin list table for posts, pages, products, and custom post types
  • Shows the exact date and time a post was last updated
  • Displays the user who last modified the content
  • Seamlessly integrates with the WordPress admin interface
  • No configuration required, Just install and activate
  • Includes a built-in tutorial page under Settings → Tutorial (TW PMT) with video guidance

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it via the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to Posts, Pages, or any public WooCommerce Products/Custom Post Type in your WordPress admin.
  4. Look for the new Last Modified column, that’s it!
sections.faq:
Does this work with custom post types and WooCommerce Products?

Yes, it works with all public Custom Post Types and WooCommerce Products that support the admin UI.

Who is this plugin for?

Bloggers, editors, content managers, developers, anyone who needs to track post activity and authorship.

Will it impact performance?

No, it won’t. This is a simple, lightweight plugin that has minimal impact on your site.

Where can I view a tutorial?

You’ll find a full usage tutorial under Settings → Tutorial (TW PMT).

What timezone does the plugin use?

The plugin follows the timezone set in your WordPress settings.
